text:
jess_sales: FYI — Acme hit a 413 on the demo upload. They sent a large HTML blob with embedded fonts and got `HTTP/1.1 413 Request Entity Too Large` during our call.
acme_poc: repro steps — our client posts the HTML as `Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-16le` and we upload the whole file in one request.
acme_poc: repro snippet:\n```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" \
  -H "Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-16le" \
  --data-binary @payload.html
# response:
HTTP/1.1 413 Request Entity Too Large
```\n
oliver_se: thanks — guess is UTF-16LE doubles the byte size vs char count and gateway enforces byte limit. Do you have the byte size reported by your client?
acme_poc: client shows ~4.2MB (chars) but `stat` shows ~8.4MB on disk. gateway limit is 8MB so it crosses it.
mike_sre: confirmed our hosted edge default is 8,388,608 bytes. If their payload is 8.4MB it will 413. We can do a short-term bump for the demo route if needed.
ingrid_eng: logs show `client_payload_size`=8799234 and the ingress rejected it. Also noticed a bunch of NULs in the first bytes (UTF-16 NULs) which made some parsers treat the body differently — multipart detectors flagged as binary.
tara_devex: short-term client workarounds: re-encode to UTF-8 before sending or send as base64 in JSON. Node example: `const buf = Buffer.from(fs.readFileSync('payload.html'), 'utf16le'); const utf8 = buf.toString('utf8');` — that drops the doubled size.
oliver_se: options for POC: 1) temporary gateway bump to 12MB for `acct-acme-demo` (mike) 2) devex share small client patch to re-encode to UTF-8 (tara) 3) longer-term: use presigned S3 chunked upload + send URLs or streaming endpoint to avoid single large POST.
acme_poc: we prefer not to change our CMS pipeline today. Can you do the gateway bump for tomorrow's demo?
mike_sre: I can make a 12MB route override for 48h. Will schedule change and post change id here.
deploy-bot: API Gateway change queued: route `acct-acme-demo` max_body_bytes -> 12582912 (12MB). change_id=chg-3456
ingrid_eng: added a short log rule to surface `charset=utf-16le` hits so we can proactively flag customers. Also added a note to model onboarding checklist.
tara_devex: I pushed a 2-line patch to the Node SDK with auto-detect -> convert UTF-16 to UTF-8 and a fallback flag `forceUtf8Upload`. I'll DM the patch to Acme.
jess_sales: locking this plan. Mike do the bump, Tara share patch, Oliver confirm fallback docs. I’ll let Acme know and schedule the retest. :thumbsup:
acme_poc: thanks all — will run verification as soon as change is live and report back.
